content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation requires contracting authorities to provide a notice to candidates and tenderers of their decision to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement, subject to certain exemptions.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: The notice must include:
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: criteria for awarding the contract
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: the name of the successful tenderer to be awarded the contract or to become a party to the framework agreement
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: the score (if any) obtained by the tenderer which is to receive the notice
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: the score obtained by the tenderer to be awarded the contract, or to become a party to the framework agreement (as applicable)
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: reasons for the decision, including characteristics and relative advantages of the successful tender
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: reasons (if applicable) where the contracting authority considered the tenderer receiving the notice did not meet the technical specifications
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: the anticipated end-date of the standstill period, or the date before which the contracting authority will not enter into the contract or conclude the framework agreement.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Information may be withheld from the notice if its release would impede law enforcement, harm a particular supplier's commercial interests, or prejudice fair competition.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: The requirement to provide a notice in accordance with this regulation does not apply where the contract or framework agreement can be awarded without prior publication of a contract notice, or where there is only one tenderer. Additionally, the contracting authority is not required to provide a notice where the contract relates to an award under a framework agreement or Dynamic Purchasing System.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Separately, the contracting authority is not required to provide a notice to:
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: any candidate informed of the rejection of its request to participate and reasons for such rejection, and
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: any tenderer informed of its rejection and where the time limit for commencing proceedings has expired.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Subject to relevant exemptions, contracting authorities must provide a notice (according with the information required by this regulation, i.e. regulation 86 PCR 2015) to candidates and tenderers of their decision to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement. The notice must also confirm the anticipated end-date of the standstill period, or date before which the contracting authority will not enter into the contract or conclude the framework agreement.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Objective at this commercial stage

Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should:
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement include all the information required by this regulation (i.e. regulation 86)
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that appropriate templates are in place for the purposes of providing all information required in the award notification, in accordance with this regulation
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: issue the award notifications to all eligible candidates and tenderers
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: consider whether any exemptions apply in relation to providing a notice and / or whether information may be withheld from the notice, in accordance with this regulation.
heading_path: Notices of decisions to award a contract or conclude a framework agreement
